news.title: These Finland homes get free heat from bitcoin miners (as long as BTC stays above $70,000)
news.summary: A Finnish startup has 30 bitcoin mining systems working as central heating, and at today’s prices each one earns slightly more than the electricity it burns.

news.title: Binance users in some European countries told to pull crypto before fees kick in, with accounts closing by year end
news.summary: Affected accounts are reportedly set to close on Dec. 31. Users in Spain, France, and Poland say they've received similar notices.

news.title: U.S. Treasury moves to cut off crypto exchange MEXC over $16 billion in alleged illicit flows
news.summary: Treasury billed the move as part of its campaign against Iran, but the order rests on MEXC's alleged role in Russian illicit finance.

news.title: Gnosis Pay breach exposes card numbers, home addresses and linked crypto wallets
news.summary: One user said the exposed data tied his home address and card number to every crypto wallet linked to his account, raising the risk of targeted scams.

news.title: Apple, Meta reject OKX–ICE tokenized stock plans, leaving crypto firms as the ones to watch
news.summary: Strategy, Coinbase, Circle and Robinhood are among six companies from the venture’s initial selection with no disclosed objection, after 90% of issuers opted out.

news.title: U.S. prediction markets regulator issues demand that clashes directly with courts
news.summary: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission said regulated exchanges can't cut off customers state-by-state, but firms like Kalshi are under court orders to do so.

news.title: The crypto industry has found new ways to grow. Making money from them is another story
news.summary: Coinbase, Robinhood and Circle are expanding into stablecoins, payments and prediction markets, but their latest earnings show how hard it is to escape crypto's boom-and-bust cycles.

news.title: Thailand moves to block Bitget as crypto exchange's local acquisition faces uncertainty
news.summary: Thailand’s SEC filed a criminal complaint against Bitget’s operator, alleging it ran an unlicensed crypto exchange for Thai users from 2022 to 2025.

news.title: This market signal called the tech selloff. Now it’s sending another warning.
news.summary: Correlations between individual stocks recently hit a record low, and a reversion to the mean may not be a good thing for the market.

news.title: This retired professor has reinvented himself — as a Taylor Swift scholar
news.summary: His niece convinced him to spend his retirement analyzing Taylor Swift lyrics. Now he’s a successful podcaster at 72.
